Apple TV today released the trailer for 《夜曲》, a brand new thriller adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling crime novel 《The Sandman》.

《夜曲》is a brand new thriller, premiering on October 30.

Apple TV's library has quite a few excellent crime thriller dramas, and they plan to add even more works this autumn.

One of them is 《夜曲》, adapted from Lars Kepler's bestselling novel 《The Sandman》.

《夜曲》will premiere on Friday, October 30, with the first two episodes dropping first, followed by one new episode every week until the finale on December 25.

The series revolves around a serial killer, starring Liev Schreiber and Zazie Beetz, with Stephen Graham from 《Adolescence》 playing the killer.

Apple just released the trailer, giving everyone a glimpse of what this eerie new work really looks like. Below is the official synopsis and trailer for 《夜曲》.

Two weeks before 《夜曲》premieres, another crime thriller 《12 12 12》will be available on Apple TV first, starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, revolving around a heist, depicting 12 months of planning, a 12-hour operation, and the 12 days following the operation.

Looking beyond autumn, Apple plans to kick off 2027 with the highly anticipated thriller 《The Wanted Man》, starring Hugh Laurie as an organized crime boss.

Will you watch when 《夜曲》premieres next month? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.

Apple TV costs USD 14.99 per month, or you can subscribe via Apple One bundle for a discount.
